t.E1203.agn: In 2006 EFSA evaluated the use of polyvinyl alcohol as a coating agent in food supplements; because the full text of the opinion could not be read for this work, its conclusion is not reported here. In the EU it is authorised only in food supplement capsules and tablets; its purity criteria are defined in the JECFA specification.
t.E1203.body: Polyvinyl alcohol is almost not absorbed from the gut: in rats, more than 98% of the dose was excreted in faeces within 48 hours, and less than 0.2% was found in urine.
t.E1203.eff.0.t: The conclusion of the 2006 EFSA opinion could not be read; no known side effect was found in this work
t.E1203.found.0: Food supplement capsules and tablets (in the EU only in these, up to 18,000 mg/kg)
t.E1203.prod: A polymer produced by chemical synthesis.
t.E1203.regx.0: Only in food supplement capsules and tablets, up to 18,000 mg/kg.
t.E1203.regx.1: Its use as a coating agent in food supplements was evaluated (the text of the opinion could not be read).
t.E1203.summary: A synthetic polymer. It is used in the coating of supplement tablets.
t.E1203.what: A synthetic polymer used as a coating agent in food supplement tablets and capsules.
